name: Avi Srivastava
title: Assistant Professor
bio: Avi is an Assistant Professor at The Wistar Institute in Philadelphia, where he started his lab in September 2023. He is a computational biologist by training and by temperament — his research sits at the intersection of statistical machine learning, high-performance algorithms, and modern functional genomics. The lab builds isoform-resolved single-cell platforms (BenchDrop-seq), probabilistic quantification methods (salmon · alevin · alevin-fry · Bagpiper), and multimodal integration frameworks underlying Signac and Seurat v5. His work has appeared in Nature Methods, Nature Biotechnology, Cell, Genome Biology, Bioinformatics, and Nature Reviews Genetics. Before joining Wistar, Avi was a postdoctoral fellow with Rahul Satija at the New York Genome Center and NYU. He earned his Ph.D. in Computer Science at Stony Brook University, advised by Rob Patro.
